This is a SAFE rejection — the provider correctly refused to bind to the wrong branch. No phone extracted. Demonstrates that multi-branch businesses require precise querying.

categoryComparison.crossCategoryObservation: The canary demonstrates that contact state (weak vs. existing) does not directly cause different Google discovery behavior — identity binding depends on name/locality/address/website alignment independent of contact state. The two executed prospects show the full range: successful identity verification (A, no prior contact) and safe identity rejection (B, name/naming mismatch). Budget exhaustion for C was unrelated to contact state.
